caption:
$5 a day. Where does it go? ☕

One makes coffee at home and drops a coin in the jar. One buys it every day. Day 30, an impulse buy. Next morning, coin in the jar again. A year later: $1,420 saved vs $1,825 on coffee.

Same coffee. Different year.

Send this to your coffee friend.

#money #saving #habits #discipline #motivation
